sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि॥
transliteration:
Karmanye vadhikaraste Ma Phaleshu Kadachana,
Ma Karmaphalaheturbhurma Te Sangostvakarmani
english: You have the right to perform your duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions. Never consider yourself the cause of the results of your activities, and never be attached to not doing your duty.
hinglish: Bhai, apna kaam karo puri dedication se, lekin result ka tension mat lo. Jo hoga, achha hoga. Bas karte raho — yahi life ka real game hai! 🔥

quiz.question: What does this shloka say about the fruits of your actions?
options: You should always focus on results
You have no right to perform duties
You have no right to the fruits of your actions
Fruits are more important than actions

english: O son of Kunti, the contact between the senses and the sense objects gives rise to fleeting perceptions of happiness and distress. These are non-permanent, and come and go like winter and summer seasons. O descendent of Bharata, one must learn to tolerate them without being disturbed.
hinglish: Yaar, yeh jo sukh-dukh hain, yeh toh bass aate-jaate rehte hain jaise mausam. Kabhi garam, kabhi thanda. Chill maar, sab theek ho jaayega. Don't let it hit different! 😎

quiz.question: According to this shloka, happiness and sorrow are:

sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
transliteration:
Uddhared aatmanaatmaanam naatmaanamavasaadayet,
Atmaiva hyaatmano bandhur aatmaiva ripur aatmanah
english: One must elevate oneself by one's own mind, and not degrade oneself. The mind is the friend of the conditioned soul, and the mind is also the enemy.
hinglish: Tu hi apna dost hai, tu hi apna dushman. Teri mindset hi teri sabse badi power hai. Khud ko lift karo bhai, koi aur nahi karega. Self-belief is everything! 💪

quiz.question: Who is your best friend and worst enemy according to this shloka?

sanskrit:
न जायते म्रियते वा कदाचिन्नायं भूत्वा भविता वा न भूयः।
अजो नित्यः शाश्वतोऽयं पुराणो न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीरे॥
transliteration:
Na jaayate mriyate vaa kadaachin naayam bhootvaa bhavitaa vaa na bhooyah,
Ajo nityah shaashvato'yam puraano na hanyate hanyamaane shareere
english: The soul is never born nor dies at any time. It has not come into being, does not come into being, and will not come into being. It is unborn, eternal, ever-existing, and primeval. It is not slain when the body is slain.
hinglish: Bhai, asli wala 'tu' toh kabhi marega hi nahi. Body toh bas ek dress hai — change hoti rehti hai. Soul is eternal yaar, isse koi nahi touch kar sakta. Big facts! ✨

quiz.question: What does Krishna say about the soul in this verse?
options: The soul dies with the body
The soul is eternal and never born or dies
The soul belongs to God only

sanskrit:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः।
स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते॥
transliteration:
Yadyadaacharati shreshthas tattadevetaro janah,
Sa yatpramanam kurute lokastadanuvartate
english: Whatever actions a great person performs, common people follow. And whatever standards they set by exemplary acts, all the world pursues.
hinglish: Jab bade log kuch karte hain, toh baaki sab unhe follow karte hain. Toh bhai, tu bhi apne actions pe dhyan de — log dekh rahe hain. Be the example! 🌟

quiz.question: This shloka teaches us about the importance of:
options: Being a good leader and role model

sanskrit:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्॥
transliteration:
Trividham narakasyedam dvaaram naashanam aatmanah,
Kaamah krodhas tathaa lobhas tasmad etat trayam tyajet
english: There are three gates to self-destructive hell: lust, anger, and greed. Therefore, one must abandon all three.
hinglish: Yaar, teen cheezein hain jo life barbad karti hain — kaam-vasna, gussa, aur lalach. Ye tino tere worst enemies hain. Inse dur reh, life set ho jaayegi! 🚫

quiz.question: What are the three gates to self-destruction mentioned in this shloka?

sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते॥
transliteration:
Dhyaayato vishayaan pumsah sangas teshupajaayate,
Sangaat sanjaayate kaamah kaamaat krodho'bhi jaayate
english: While contemplating the objects of the senses, a person develops attachment for them, and from such attachment lust develops, and from lust anger arises.
hinglish: Yaar, jab tu kisi cheez ke baare mein zyada sochta rehta hai, toh attachment ho jaati hai. Attachment se desire, desire se frustration, frustration se anger. Social media doom scrolling bilkul yahi hai! 📱

quiz.question: What leads to anger according to this shloka?

sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम्॥
transliteration:
Yadaa yadaa hi dharmasya glaanir bhavati bhaarat,
Abhyutthanam adharmasya tadaatmaanam srijaamyaham
english: Whenever there is a decline in righteousness and an increase in unrighteousness, O Arjuna, at that time I manifest myself on earth.
hinglish: Jab bhi duniya mein burai badhti hai aur achhai khatam hoti lagti hai — tab God himself step in karta hai. System corrupt ho toh reset aata hai. Trust the process! ⚡

quiz.question: When does Krishna say he manifests on Earth?
options: When righteousness declines and evil rises

sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः॥
transliteration:
Sarva-dharmaan parityajya maam ekam sharanam vraja,
Aham tvaa sarva-paapebhyo mokshayishyaami maa shuchah
english: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions. Do not fear.
hinglish: Sab theories, sab ego, sab calculations chod de — bas surrender kar aur trust kar. Tab God personally handle karega tera saara mess. No stress, no fear! 🙏

quiz.question: What promise does Krishna make in this final verse?
options: He will deliver us from all sins if we surrender to him

sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम्।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते॥
transliteration:
Asanshayam mahaabaaho mano durnigraham chalam,
Abhyaasena tu kaunteya vairaagyena cha grihyate
english: Lord Krishna said: O mighty-armed son of Kunti, what you say is correct; the mind is indeed very difficult to restrain. But by practice and detachment, it can be controlled.
hinglish: Haan yaar, mind control karna mushkil hai — yeh toh sachchi baat hai. Lekin bhai, practice aur detachment se ho jaata hai. Gym jaisi cheez hai — roz karo, results milenge! 🧠💪

quiz.question: How can the restless mind be controlled according to Krishna?

sanskrit:
क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते।
क्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप॥
transliteration:
Klaibyam maa sma gamah paartha naitat tvayyupapadyate,
Kshudram hridayadaurbalyam tyaktvo ttishtha parantapa
english: O Partha, do not yield to this degrading impotence. It does not become you. Give up such petty weakness of heart and arise, O scorcher of enemies.
hinglish: Arjun ko Krishna ne literally bola — yaar, yeh weakness suit nahi karti tujhe. Uth! Weak mat ban. Tu capable hai — toh act kar uski tarah. Wake up bhai! 🔥

quiz.question: What is Krishna asking Arjuna to do in this verse?

sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति॥
transliteration:
Na hi jnaanena sadrisham pavitram iha vidyate,
Tat svayam yoga-samsiddhah kaale naatmani vindati
english: In this world, there is nothing so sublime and pure as transcendental knowledge. Such knowledge is the mature fruit of all mysticism. And one who has achieved this enjoys the self within himself in due course of time.
hinglish: Yaar, knowledge se badi koi cheez nahi. Padhna, seekhna, grow karna — yahi sabse bada flex hai. Time ke saath sab pata chalta hai. Stay curious! 📚✨

quiz.question: What does Krishna consider the most pure and sublime thing in this world?
